title: Adventurous Downtown Scavenger Hunt in Detroit
includes: 2 hours with a remote interactive guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Detroit in a way you never thought possible with Crazy Dash, an app-based scavenger hunt that’s built for fun and flexibility in any city. We've replaced rigid itineraries and tour guides with a unique, self-paced adventure.

What makes us different? Our live remote hosts. They're real people available via chat to give you hints, answer questions, and provide encouragement. You get personalized support, making your experience smooth and enjoyable no matter where you play.

The missions are all about laughter. You’ll complete hilarious photo and video challenges to earn points, turning your exploration into a playful game. Compete for a top spot on our nationwide leaderboards or just play for the pure joy of discovery.

Perfect for dates, family outings, and team building, Crazy Dash is the ultimate way to explore the city your way.
